ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 20-25% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in distal lateral regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottled/brushed regions localized on the distal lateral thirds of both lobes; central region and proximal edges are solid low-intensity black with sparse, isolated point-source high-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, obtuse V-shaped depression at the central midline with a shallow vertical depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitudes; peaks are more pronounced on the medial sections of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Smooth concave upward curvature extending symmetrically from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Uniformly distributed high-contrast circular white pixel clusters across the entire visible ventral surface; significant high-density clustering (colonization) at both the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible primarily within the white mottled regions of the distal lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (barnacle clusters) at both distal tips, causing jagged protrusion beyond the natural geometric edge of the lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density 'starlit' texture across the central dark pigmentation caused by hundreds of small, isolated white point-source markings.
